_help.conformal_coating: true -> external spacing from the 'with conformal coating' columns
_help.outer_copper_includes_plating: false: stackup outer copper thickness = base foil, plating added below
_help.outer_plating_um: plated copper added on external layers when the line above is false
_help.bond_sequence: 'single' (450 um hole wall to hole wall) or 'sequential' (650 um)
_help.courtyard_margin_mm: courtyard margin around body+pads (0 = tight courtyards)
_help.chip_footprint_regex: footprint IDs considered chip devices (Track <= 1/3 pad width)
_help.chip_two_pad_heuristic: also treat any footprint with exactly 2 SMD pads as a chip device
_help.screw_head_diameter_mm: null -> A5 (track to screw) not checked; else screw head diameter
_help.edge_zone_mm: width of the component-free zone along the PCB edge
_help.edge_zone_exempt_ref_regex: components allowed inside the edge zone (e.g. '^(H|J)')
_help.default_copper_um: copper thickness used when the board has no stackup section
